native_provenance.scope: CSV inverse transform only; not an archive decoder; local performance unmeasured

protocol.archives: two deterministic encodings; same archive file for both backends
protocol.restore: one labelled warmup and five default formal fresh-process restores per condition; all jobs shuffled; hash/load/FFI/copies/codec/integrity included
protocol.ranges: all conditions, rounds and modes shuffled; actual requests matched across conditions
protocol.cache: pre-read archive; warm OS cache; process initialization excluded from warmed range queries
protocol.rust_scope: exact CSV v1 inverse only; encoding/codecs/SHA/file IO remain Python or existing libraries
protocol.cost: complete archive plus separately reported DLL and metadata deployment cost
protocol.rss: full restoration in separate workers; range includes truth and analytical ledger reader

limits: single host, warm cache, background load uncontrolled; no significance or universal optimum claim
process-level load cache requires immutable trusted library; shared/system dependencies not fully measured
native archive bytes unchanged; no Rust codec, hash, encoder or append-only CAS result
